results.title: Africa: Essential Minerals - A Trillion-Dollar "Launchpad"
results.snippet:
The Somaïr mine became the focal point of a dispute between Niger and Orano after the Nigerien government took over and declared the project nationalized. Niamey argued that the joint venture's mining license had expired and accused Orano of engaging in activities inconsistent with Niger's interests. The dispute has hampered uranium mining and export operations.
